text: In my country it's largely about social expectations. A wedding is seen as a way of showing respect to relatives and the community, so families feel they can't invite only fifty people without offending someone. There's also an element of status — nobody wants their celebration to look modest compared with the neighbours'. Unfortunately, some young couples start married life in debt because of it.

tips.en: The reason comes from social expectations, not personal taste.
tips.kk: Жеке талғам емес, қоғамның күтуі арқылы түсіндіру.
tips.ru: Объяснение через ожидания общества, а не личный вкус.

tips.en: Unfortunately … in debt ends the answer with a real result.
tips.kk: Unfortunately … in debt — жауап нақты нәтижемен аяқталады.
tips.ru: Unfortunately … in debt — ответ заканчивается реальным результатом.
tips.example: some young couples start married life in debt

questions.question: Why do some families spend so much money on weddings?

text: The biggest difference is probably the scale and the style. My grandparents had a simple celebration at home, with food cooked by relatives, whereas today most couples hire a restaurant, a photographer and even a professional host. Weddings have also become more international — you see white dresses and Western-style cakes alongside traditional ceremonies. In a way, they've become a mix of old and new.

tips.en: Whereas compares the grandparents' wedding with a modern one using details.
tips.kk: Whereas әжесінің тойы мен қазіргі тойды салыстырады — жалпы сөз емес, дерек.
tips.ru: Whereas сравнивает свадьбу бабушки с современной — детали, а не общие слова.
tips.example: whereas today most couples hire a restaurant

tips.en: In a way … a mix of old and new gives a short conclusion.
tips.kk: In a way … a mix of old and new — қысқа қорытынды.
tips.ru: In a way … a mix of old and new — короткий вывод.
tips.example: they've become a mix of old and new

questions.question: How are weddings today different from those in the past?

text: More than you might expect. A few years ago, many young people seemed to see traditions as old-fashioned, but now there's a real revival of interest, partly thanks to social media, where people share videos of ceremonies like betashar. I think for many young Kazakhs it's a way of expressing their identity. Of course, they often adapt the traditions, making them shorter or more personal.

tips.en: More than you might expect is a more interesting start than yes.
tips.kk: More than you might expect — жай «иә» дегеннен қызығырақ.
tips.ru: More than you might expect — интереснее простого «да».

tips.en: Revival and partly thanks to show what changed and why.
tips.kk: Revival және partly thanks to — не өзгерді және неге.
tips.ru: Revival и partly thanks to — что изменилось и почему.
tips.example: there's a real revival of interest, partly thanks to social media

note.en: “A way to show who they are”.

phrases.text: a way of expressing their identity

questions.question: Are traditional ceremonies still important for young people?

text: To some extent, yes, especially when it comes to things like traditional music, crafts and language, which can disappear surprisingly quickly. Funding museums, festivals and school programmes is a sensible way to keep them alive. However, I don't think governments should try to force people to follow customs. Traditions survive best when people choose them because they find them meaningful, not because they're told to.

tips.en: Support yes, force no — a view with a clear limit.
tips.kk: Қолдау — иә, мәжбүрлеу — жоқ: шекарасы анық ұстаным.
tips.ru: Поддерживать — да, заставлять — нет: позиция с чёткой границей.
tips.example: I don't think governments should try to force people to follow customs

tips.en: Traditions survive best when… is a general conclusion, like a thesis.
tips.kk: Traditions survive best when… — тезис секілді жалпы қорытынды.
tips.ru: Traditions survive best when… — общий вывод, как тезис.
tips.example: Traditions survive best when people choose them

questions.question: Should governments do more to protect traditions?

text: Usually, yes. In busy modern life, weddings and birthdays are often the only occasions when the whole extended family is in one room, so they give people a chance to reconnect. That said, they can also bring old tensions to the surface — organising a big event involves money and lots of opinions. But on balance, I'd say the benefits outweigh the occasional argument.

tips.en: That said brings in a downside after an upside.
tips.kk: That said артықшылықтан кейін кемшілікті енгізеді.
tips.ru: That said вводит минус после плюса.
tips.example: they can also bring old tensions to the surface

tips.en: On balance … outweigh is a useful way to conclude in Part 3.
tips.kk: On balance … outweigh — Part 3 үшін қорытынды формуласы.
tips.ru: On balance … outweigh — формула итога для Part 3.
tips.example: on balance, I'd say the benefits outweigh the occasional argument

questions.question: Do you think big family celebrations bring people closer together?
